name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2019-07-23.113.1) introduced by MP for Isaacs [Mark Dreyfus](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/isaacs/mark_dreyfus) (Labor), which means they failed. ### What were the amendments? MP Dreyfus [explained that the amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2019-07-23.113.1): > *ensure that the bill conforms to the unanimous and bipartisan recommendations of Labor and government members of the intelligence committee—no more, no less ... there are 10, or possibly 11, of the unanimous recommendations of the committee that have not been agreed to by the government.* MP Dreyfus then went through each of the recommendations of the Parliamentary Joint Committee on Intelligence and Security that the government didn't implement, and set out how the Labor Party has sought to give effect to the recommendations in the amendments. ### What do the bills do?
